name: 01 - Inbound Quote Request (extract, score, approval gate)

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO manual_review_queue (idempotency_key, source, payload, reason)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO leads (
  idempotency_key, source, contact, enquiry,
  extraction, estimated_value_aud, confidence, status
)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4, $5::jsonb, $6, $7, $8)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE
  SET extraction = EXCLUDED.extraction,
      updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, status;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ external_ref: $('Parse & Score Risk').first().json.idempotencyKey, contact: $('Parse & Score Risk').first().json.contact, description: $('Parse & Score Risk').first().json.extracted.scope_summary, trade: $('Parse & Score Risk').first().json.extracted.service_type, urgency: $('Parse & Score Risk').first().json.extracted.urgency }) }}
